video.en: In Henning's study, when people watched videos of scratching, they scratched themselves spontaneously.
video.zh: 在 Henning 的研究中，人们在观看挠痒视频时，会不由自主地挠起自己来。

video.en: Or they go online and leave comments on YouTube videos or blog articles.
video.zh: 或者他们上网在YouTube视频或博客文章下留言。

video.en: Henning and his team studied what happened when people watched videos of itching and scratching.
video.zh: Henning 和他的团队研究了人们在观看挠痒视频时会有怎样的反应。

video.en: Podcasts or videos. My conversation and speaking groups, the Conversation Club on Patreon.
video.zh: 播客或视频。我的交流和口语小组，Patreon上的对话俱乐部。

video.en: There are millions of videos or podcasts online introducing lists of idioms for English learners.
video.zh: 网上有数百万个视频或播客，专门为英语学习者介绍各种习语列表。

visual.en: The adjective visual describes things related to seeing, while auditory means related to hearing.
visual.zh: 形容词 visual 用来描述与视觉相关的事物，而 auditory 意思是与听觉相关的。

visual.en: The adjective visual means related to seeing, and auditory means related to hearing.
visual.zh: 形容词 visual 意思是与视觉相关的，auditory 意思是与听觉相关的。

visual.en: And just the visual of her walking through and looking at everything.
visual.zh: 还有她走过并环顾四周的那个画面。

visual.en: Black and white stripes created an optical illusion, a visual trick that makes your eyes see things differently from how they really are.
visual.zh: 黑白条纹创造了一种 optical illusion（视觉错觉），这是一种让你的眼睛看到与实际情况不同事物的视觉把戏。

visual.en: A circuit is a system of connections. The visual qualities of Chinese symbols inevitably mean more visual areas of the brain are developed.
visual.zh: 电路是一个连接系统。中文符号的视觉特质不可避免地意味着大脑更多的视觉区域得到了发展。

visible.en: Language is the most obvious, the most visible, the most measurable sign of this.
visible.zh: 语言是最明显、最直观、最可衡量的标志。

visible.en: When cameras are visible on buildings or on lamp posts, they can discourage criminal behavior.
visible.zh: 当摄像头显眼地安装在建筑物上或电线杆上时，它们可以起到威慑犯罪行为的作用。

visible.en: Chinese takeaways in every town. Caribbean food is quite visible, especially in places like London.
visible.zh: 每个城镇都有中餐外卖。加勒比食物也很常见，尤其是在伦敦等地。

visible.en: So confidence is often visible through your behavior rather than your language ability.
visible.zh: 所以，与其说自信体现在语言能力上，倒不如说它往往是通过你的行为表现出来的。

visible.en: Open dormitories. Shared dining halls with long, visible sight lines.
visible.zh: 开放式宿舍。共享的餐厅，视线长且一览无余。

viewpoint.en: And of course, in the Marxist viewpoint, you're a pawn of your class: you're oppressed often.
viewpoint.zh: 当然，在马克思主义的观点里，你是所属阶级的棋子：常常是被压迫的一方。

viewpoint.en: And it's looked at through the viewpoint of not a funny song, but a man in black will do this.
viewpoint.zh: 这对那些专辑来说是很重要的一部分。

viewpoint.en: If you are of one mind, you are of a group of people that share the same opinion, desire, or viewpoint on a matter.
viewpoint.zh: 如果你是 of one mind（意见一致），你就是属于对某个问题持有相同意见、愿望或观点的群体。

viewpoint.en: To be of one mind is to be part of a group of people that share the same opinion, desire, or viewpoint on a matter.
viewpoint.zh: to be of one mind 是指属于对某个问题持有相同意见、愿望或观点的群体的一部分。

viewpoint.en: That the debate really wasn't entirely about, do you honor figures from the past, even if we completely disavow their viewpoints now?
viewpoint.zh: 这场争论其实从来都不只是关于：我们是否应该纪念过去的人物，即便我们如今已经完全否定他们的观点？

visitor.en: This brings opportunities and pressure. Too many visitors can cause damage.
visitor.zh: 这既带来了机遇，也带来了压力。过多的游客可能会造成破坏。

visitor.en: But the character that Pepys saw that afternoon was still, in every meaningful sense, an Italian visitor.
visitor.zh: 但 Pepys 那天下午看到的那个角色，在任何有意义的层面上，依然是一个来自意大利的访客。

visitor.en: These things attract many visitors interested in wildlife and diving.
visitor.zh: 这些吸引了许多对野生动物和潜水感兴趣的游客。

visitor.en: Either way, with an estimated 700 million visitors every year, zoos remain popular – but are they a good thing?
visitor.zh: 无论如何，每年估计有7亿游客，动物园依然很受欢迎——但它们真的是一件好事吗？

visitor.en: And the city attracts millions of visitors every year.
visitor.zh: 这座城市每年吸引着数以百万计的游客。

view.en: The pessimistic view is that we're not in a traditional bubble waiting to pop.
view.zh: 悲观的看法是，我们并不是身处一个等待破裂的传统泡沫中。

view.en: All he wanted was for his views to be published in a major newspaper.
view.zh: 他想要的只是把自己的观点发表在一家大报上。

view.en: What is talent? Well, in my view, talent is one of the components of ability.
view.zh: 什么是天赋？好吧，在我看来，天赋是能力的组成部分之一。

view.en: Will's view of the world became distorted – twisted out of shape and unrealistic.
view.zh: Will 对世界的看法变得扭曲(distorted)——也就是变形失真、脱离现实。

view.en: You know, the billions and billions of views it was doing at that point.
view.zh: 你知道，它当时获得的数十亿次观看。

vision.en: Streets, cities, rivers, and even clothing were swept up in this new cultural vision.
vision.zh: 街道、城市、河流甚至服装都被卷入了这股新的文化愿景中。

vision.en: He cracked down on dissent, exiling or imprisoning those who opposed his vision.
vision.zh: 他严厉打击异见，将那些反对他愿景的人流放或关入监狱。

vision.en: This was Schumpeter's great vision and insight, and I've just been talking about that.
vision.zh: 这正是熊彼特那伟大的远见和洞察，我刚才一直在谈的也正是这个。

vision.en: Avoid tunnel vision. Keep difficult things in one part of your life from contaminating everything else.
vision.zh: 避免管窥效应。把生活中某个部分的难题与其余部分隔离开来。

vision.en: And he really had a vision of it being something different than that.
vision.zh: 而他确实有一个与此不同的愿景。

via.en: For example, you could, via genetics, smell coriander or taste coriander differently.
via.zh: 例如，由于基因原因，你闻到香菜或品尝香菜的味道可能会有所不同。

via.en: And Dana says that you could taste food differently to others via genetics.
via.zh: 达娜说，通过基因，你对食物的品尝方式可能会与他人不同。

via.en: You have to ship things across the world via expensive boats.
via.zh: 你必须通过昂贵的船只将物品运送过世界。

via.en: For a while, all went well. Fawcett sent intermittent updates via runners who carried letters back to the edges of the jungle, where telegraphs could relay his words to the wider world.
via.zh: 有一段时间，一切都很顺利。Fawcett 通过信使断断续续地发回消息，信使将信件带到丛林边缘，再由电报将他的话语传送到更广阔的世界。

vine.en: Did you know, for example, that peppers are the fruit of vines often growing over ten metres high?
vine.zh: 比如，你知道胡椒是藤本植物的果实，而且这些藤蔓通常能长到十米以上吗？

vine.en: He built pleasure-galleys to cruise the Bay of Naples: vast ships with baths, colonnades, banquet-halls and even vines.
vine.zh: 他建造了游艇去巡游那不勒斯湾：配有浴室、柱廊、宴会厅甚至葡萄藤的巨大船只。

vital.en: The port of Aqaba, on the Red Sea, was a vital Ottoman stronghold.
vital.zh: 红海沿岸的阿卡巴港是奥斯曼帝国的重要据点。

vital.en: Trees and food, fresh water, and the survival of people are vital.
vital.zh: 树木与食物、淡水以及人们的生存都是至关重要的。

vital.en: And this will be of vital importance to the rest of our story.
vital.zh: 这对我们接下来的故事至关重要。

vital.en: In other words, energy security became of vital importance.
vital.zh: 换句话说，能源安全变得至关重要。

vital.en: Some see it as a vital tool for international cooperation.
vital.zh: 有些人认为它是国际合作不可或缺的工具。

violence.en: Day and night, people occupied the square, camping out despite the threat of violence.
violence.zh: 日以继夜，人们占领了广场，不顾暴力威胁在那里露营。

violence.en: When it exploded, injuring a security officer, his 17-year campaign of violence had begun.
violence.zh: 当它爆炸并炸伤一名保安时，他长达 17 年的暴力行动开始了。

violence.en: Domestic abuse charities have argued that the show makes light of violence in the home.
violence.zh: 家庭虐待慈善机构认为，该节目将家庭暴力轻描淡写。

violence.en: Leaders came and went. Power often changed hands through violence rather than elections.
violence.zh: 领导人走马灯似地换。权力往往通过暴力而非选举易手。

violence.en: Could be violence, could be a lot of things that would not be good.
violence.zh: 可能是暴力，也可能是很多其他不好的事情。

vinegar.en: Is it: a) salt and vinegar? b) cheese and onion? or, c) prawn cocktail?
vinegar.zh: 是 a) 盐醋味？b) 奶酪洋葱味？还是 c) 鸡尾酒虾味？

vinegar.en: I think my favourite is salt and vinegar.
vinegar.zh: 我觉得我最喜欢的是盐醋味。

vinegar.en: The most obvious choice is fish and chips: fried fish, usually cod or haddock, with thick-cut chips served with salt and vinegar.
vinegar.zh: 最显而易见的选择是炸鱼薯条：炸鱼（通常是鳕鱼或黑线鳕），搭配粗切薯条，撒上盐和醋。

violent.en: The plot, what actually happens in a Punch and Judy show, is famously violent.
violent.zh: 剧情——也就是 Punch and Judy 演出中实际发生的事情——以暴力闻名。

violent.en: It had already actually become violent. Fighting had started a year earlier in Massachusetts.
violent.zh: 实际上它已经演变成暴力冲突。战斗在一年前的马萨诸塞州就已经打响。

violent.en: To incite someone means to encourage them to do or feel something unpleasant or violent.
violent.zh: “煽动”某人意味着鼓励他们去做或感受到令人不快或暴力的事情。

violent.en: There are so many examples of this and of these competitions becoming violent.
violent.zh: 这方面的例子不胜枚举，这些竞争演变成暴力冲突的例子也屡见不鲜。

violent.en: It doesn’t matter that the content is designed to incite outrage – to encourage unpleasant or violent reactions.
violent.zh: 内容旨在煽动愤怒——鼓励令人不快或暴力的反应——这并不重要。

vibrate.en: So, that's the velocity that the ground is vibrating up and down.
vibrate.zh: 所以，这就是地面上下振动的速度。

vibrate.en: That's done by having an eardrum, which catches it and then vibrates sympathetically to the vibration of the noise that you heard.
vibrate.zh: 这是通过耳膜来实现的，耳膜捕捉声音，然后随着你听到的噪音的振动产生共鸣。

vibration.en: That's done by having an eardrum, which catches it and then vibrates sympathetically to the vibration of the noise that you heard.
vibration.zh: 这是通过耳膜来实现的，耳膜捕捉声音，然后随着你听到的噪音的振动产生共鸣。

vitamin.en: In 1901, there was an outbreak of a disease linked to malnutrition and vitamin deficiency.
vitamin.zh: 1901 年，爆发了一种与营养不良和维生素缺乏有关的疾病。

vitamin.en: Yes, and some expensive oils claim to contain other vitamins that are good for us.
vitamin.zh: 是的，而且一些昂贵的油声称含有对我们有益的其他维生素。

vitamin.en: By 1917, his health had begun to fail. He was diagnosed with several illnesses, including tuberculosis and vitamin deficiencies, and he spent long periods recovering in hospitals.
vitamin.zh: 到1917年，他的健康状况开始恶化。他被诊断出患有多种疾病，包括结核病和维生素缺乏症，并在医院里度过了漫长的康复期。

vitamin.en: Yes. I try to eat lots of oranges, which apparently have lots of vitamin C, and there are lots of things people do to try to improve their immune system, and stay healthier, like eating certain foods, taking vitamins, or even activities like swimming in cold water.
vitamin.zh: 有。我尽量吃很多橙子，显然它们含有大量的维生素C，人们会做很多事情来尝试改善他们的免疫系统，保持更健康，比如吃特定的食物、服用维生素，甚至像冷水游泳这样的活动。

vitamin.en: Yes. I try to eat lots of oranges, which apparently have lots of vitamin C, and there are lots of things people do to try to improve their immune system, and stay healthier, like eating certain foods, taking vitamins, or even activities like swimming in cold water.
vitamin.zh: 有。我尽量吃很多橙子，显然它们含有大量的维生素C，人们会做很多事情来尝试改善他们的免疫系统，保持更健康，比如吃特定的食物、服用维生素，甚至像冷水游泳这样的活动。

violently.en: At 315 volts, he screamed violently. After 330 volts, there was silence.
violently.zh: 到315伏特时，他发出了剧烈的尖叫。330伏特之后，一片寂静。

violently.en: Native Americans were violently removed from their land.
violently.zh: 美洲原住民被暴力驱逐出他们的土地。

violently.en: And if you ever have the terrible fortune of seeing your parents, most times your mother being in a position where she's being violently harmed, I mean, it rocks your fundamental understanding of what the world is. you know?
violently.zh: 如果你有幸看到你的父母，大多数时候是你的母亲，处于一种她正受到暴力伤害的位置，这意味着它动摇了你对世界本质的理解。

victim.en: And it is still growing. And let's say you are the victim of a crime.
victim.zh: 而且这个数字还在持续增长。再假设一下，你是某起犯罪的受害者。

victim.en: In the end, was he a dangerous criminal, a victim of the system, or its most dangerous critic?
victim.zh: 归根结底，他是一个危险的罪犯，是体制的受害者，还是体制最危险的批判者？

victim.en: Some victims, perfectly understandably, wait so long for their day in court that they simply give up and drop the charges.
victim.zh: 有些受害者——这完全可以理解——等待开庭的时间实在太长，干脆就放弃了，撤销了指控。

victim.en: They say it is satire, not instruction. They say Punch has always been a wicked character, and that the joke is on him, not on his victims.
victim.zh: 他们说这是讽刺，而不是教导。他们说 Punch 一直是个邪恶的角色，笑话是在他身上，而不是在他的受害者身上。

victim.en: Or do you think it would become a victim of the resource curse?
victim.zh: 还是你认为它会成为资源诅咒的牺牲品？

victorious.en: Israel’s allies rallied in support, and Israel proved victorious.
victorious.zh: 以色列的盟友纷纷声援，最终以色列取得了胜利。

victorious.en: The victorious Allied powers, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and the Soviet Union, divided Germany into different occupation centers.
victorious.zh: 胜利的盟军——美国、英国、法国和苏联——将德国划分成不同的占领区。

victorious.en: And if that wasn’t bad enough, its enemies—the victorious Allied powers of Britain, France, and Italy—were now circling like vultures.
victorious.zh: 如果这还不够糟糕的话，它的敌人——胜利的盟军英国、法国和意大利——现在正像秃鹰一样盘旋。

victorious.en: Shortly afterwards, the country emerged victorious from the Seven Years War, winning Britain vast new territories across North America, India, and the Caribbean.
victorious.zh: 此后不久，该国在七年战争中大获全胜，为英国赢得了横跨北美、印度和加勒比海的辽阔新领土。

victory.en: So, what happened? Why has Keir Starmer resigned after such a convincing election victory?
victory.zh: 那么，究竟发生了什么？为什么Keir Starmer在取得如此令人信服的大选胜利后会辞职呢？

victory.en: The victory convinced France that the American revolutionaries had a chance of winning the war.
victory.zh: 这场胜利让法国确信美国革命者有赢得战争的机会。

victory.en: But to anti-drug campaigners and many politicians, this was a great victory.
victory.zh: 但对于反毒品活动人士和许多政治家来说，这是一次伟大的胜利。

victory.en: In 1777, American forces achieved a major victory at the Battle of Saratoga in New York.
victory.zh: 1777年，美军在纽约的萨拉托加战役中取得了重大胜利。

victory.en: In 1871, following victory in the Franco-Prussian War, the German empire was officially proclaimed.
victory.zh: 1871年，在普法战争中获胜后，德意志帝国正式宣告成立。

virtually.en: In other words, he had lost virtually all of his brain function.
virtually.zh: 换句话说，他几乎丧失了全部脑功能。

virtually.en: And more importantly, coal appeared to be virtually limitless.
virtually.zh: 更重要的是，煤炭似乎是几乎取之不尽的。

violate.en: Most of us, Eldar included, are going to violate the Eldar rule.
violate.zh: 我们大多数人，包括 Eldar 在内，都会违反 Eldar 规则。

violate.zh: 2 月 3 日提起了一起诉讼，指控 DOGE 访问财政部系统的行为违反了联邦隐私法。

violate.en: It listed numerous grievances, like complaints, against King George III, and it argued that he had violated the rights of the colonists.

violate.en: And for anybody who did violate this message, anyone who stood against him, there were no lengths that Putin was not willing to go to to silence them.
violate.zh: 而对于任何敢于违背这一信号、任何敢于与他作对的人，普京为了让他们闭嘴，会不择一切手段。

vice.zh: 这一宣布由他的副总统发表，人群爆发出欢呼声。

vice.zh: 毫不奇怪，开国元勋们并没有把副总统设想为一个有权有势的人物。

vice.zh: 当副总统这个职位最初设立时，它几乎是一个事后才想到的补充。

vivid.en: The camps continue. But what Otto's case did was to make something vivid and undeniable that had previously been easy, for many people, to file away as abstract: North Korea is not merely strange or amusing or ideologically peculiar.
vivid.zh: 那些劳改营也仍在继续运转。但奥托的案子所起到的作用，是让一件事变得鲜活而不容否认——而在此之前，许多人很容易把这件事当作一种抽象的概念束之高阁：朝鲜不只是奇怪、好笑，或者意识形态上有些古怪而已。

vicious.zh: 狗对主人会无限忠诚，但如果接到指令，它们也会变得凶狠残暴。

vicious.en: But unfortunately, there's a reason there's a vicious cycle.
vicious.zh: 但不幸的是，恶性循环是有原因的。

virtual.zh: 学校前面带什么词并不重要，她总是喜欢这样说——公立的、私立的、特许的、在家上学的、虚拟的、磁吸的、教会学校。

virtual.en: We might also see virtual reality storytelling.
virtual.zh: 我们可能还会看到虚拟现实叙事。

virtual.zh: 而且，由于人工智能系统规模如此庞大，拥有数十亿个参数或人工神经元之间的虚拟“连接”，它们无论是训练还是运行都需要大量的能量。

virtual.en: And then the other David. And it was just three people, you know, physically making a thing that's supposed to take many, many, many people, you know, but here you are and you're this, but you're virtual and you're not in the same room as people and you can't travel.
virtual.zh: 还有另一个David。只有三个人，你知道，实际上在制作一个本应需要许多许多人制作的东西，你知道，但你在这儿，你是虚拟的，你和人们不在同一个房间里，你不能旅行。

visa.en: For most students, this visa will be reduced from two years to just 18 months.
visa.zh: 对大多数学生来说，这种签证的期限将从两年缩短到仅仅18个月。

visa.en: This is the visa a student is eligible for after they graduate from university.
visa.zh: 这是学生从大学毕业后有资格获得的签证。

visa.en: And travelers can cross borders without needing visas or passport checks.
visa.zh: 旅行者可以跨越边境，而无需签证或护照检查。

visa.en: This is really important. Someone working at the immigration agency of a country has to decide whether someone has the language skills to qualify for the visa they’re applying for.
visa.zh: 这真的很重要。一个国家移民局的工作人员必须决定某人是否具备申请签证所需的语言技能。

visa.en: Or are you passing an exam in English just to graduate from high school, or just to get admitted to university, or just to qualify for a visa or get a new job?
visa.zh: 还是你参加英语考试仅仅是为了高中毕业，或是为了被大学录取，又或是为了获得签证资格或找到新工作？

virus.en: Like we are top of the well-known food chain, but bacteria viruses eat us.
virus.zh: 我们虽然是已知食物链的顶端，但细菌和病毒会吃掉我们。

virus.en: Basically, uh, bacteria and viruses are at the top of the food chain compared to us.
virus.zh: 基本上，细菌和病毒在食物链顶端，远高于我们。

virus.en: False claims about vaccines, miracle cures, government conspiracies, and the origins of the virus circulated everywhere.
virus.zh: 关于疫苗、奇迹疗法、政府阴谋以及病毒来源的虚假声明到处流传。

virus.en: Some tulips were rare or had broken colors caused by a virus, which made them even more desirable.
virus.zh: 有些郁金香非常稀有，或者拥有由病毒引起的破色花纹，这使得它们更加抢手。

virus.en: Darwin’s ideas also affected medicine. Understanding evolution helps doctors now explain how viruses and bacteria adapts and how cancers evolve inside our bodies.
virus.zh: Darwin的思想也影响了医学。理解进化论现在可以帮助医生解释病毒和细菌是如何适应环境的，以及癌症如何在我们的体内进化。

villa.en: Famous revolutionary leaders like Pancho Villa in the North fought to give land and rights back to the ordinary people.
villa.zh: 像北方的潘乔·维拉这样的著名革命领袖为将土地和权利归还给普通人民而战。

violation.en: Another proposal is to limit the veto power, especially in situations involving genocide or other serious human rights violations.
violation.zh: 另一个提案是限制否决权，特别是在涉及种族灭绝或其他严重侵犯人权行为的情况下。

virtue.en: So patience is a virtue that I feel like I haven't had.
virtue.zh: 多年来我一直对自己说这句话。

virtue.en: And I think a lot of the virtues work this way, right?
virtue.zh: 我想很多美德都是这样运作的，对吧？

virtue.en: Maybe, but... I know we like to virtue signal and pretend we're doing it for each other.
virtue.zh: 也许吧，但……我知道我们喜欢进行道德标榜，假装我们是在为彼此着想。

virtue.en: If persistence is a virtue, generally, how is a person to know when he or she under which circumstances he or she should quit or disengage?
virtue.zh: 如果坚持通常是一种美德，一个人如何才能知道在何时、在什么情况下他或她应该放弃或退出？

virtue.en: And he makes an especially pointed point about consistency because in my opinion, it's one of the most difficult of the virtues for humans to do because we're so attracted to novelty.
virtue.zh: 他特别强调了坚持，因为在我看来，这是人类最难做到的美德之一，因为我们太被新奇事物所吸引了。

vicinity.en: And what's happened now is, you know, 100 years ago, 500 years ago, if something wasn't happening in your immediate vicinity, you wouldn't hear about it.
vicinity.zh: 现在的情况是，你知道，在 100 年前、500 年前，如果某件事不是发生在你的直接周边，你根本不会听说。

virgin.en: And I was in my 30's and now a virgin still, and your sexuality doesn't really go anywhere.
virgin.zh: 我当时三十多岁，而且依然是个处男，但你的性取向并不会真的凭空消失。
